questions.question: What did David resolve about his words?
options: To gather all his wealth and store it away safely
To guard his ways and keep a muzzle on his mouth
To raise up an army and defend his native land
To seek out true wisdom and learn the law of God
questions.answer: To guard his ways and keep a muzzle on his mouth

questions.question: How does David describe the span of human life?
options: A thousand years; man endures like the hills
A few handbreadths; man is a mere breath
An evening flower; man fades by night
A passing shadow; man returns to dust
questions.answer: A few handbreadths; man is a mere breath

questions.question: David asks the LORD to make him know his end and the measure of his days.
And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in _____.
Surely each man is but a _____!
